title: Shod's Create and TacZ Bridge
description: A mod that makes a bridge between TacZ new port and Create.
body:
A simple mod that makes a bridge between Create and TacZ for 1.21.1.

It's my first ever mod, so feel free to leave suggestions in GitHub page (planned for the future).

The mod foccus on automating ammunition through Create.

The mod has a different recipe for each type of ammo based IRL. Urban ammo is simpler than war ammo.

The ammo result is different for each tip you put in at the end of the assemble.

Example:
Brass Nugget -> Saw = Empty Brass Casing (Incomplete)

Empty Brass Casing (Incomplete) -> Press = Empty Brass Casing

Empty Brass Casing + Flint = 12g

Empty Brass Casing + Gunpowder Pinch = Primed Brass Casing

Primed Brass Casing + Zinc Nugget = 5.56x45

Primed Brass Casing + Iron Nugget = 5.45x39

Future Plans:

1- Right now, it doesn't cover all the ammo (it covers 13 of them), but it's planned to do.

2- Instead of single recipes for each mod components (mainly the ammo casings), the idea is to make a proccess assembling (like precision mechanisms) - give a feedback in the comments.

3- Make empty casings in loot-tables for chests.

Dependencies:

[Create](https://modrinth.com/project/LNytGWDc)

[Create: Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/project/GWp4jCJj)

[[UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ 1.21.1 NeoForge Port](https://modrinth.com/project/OypNE65K)
